title: Trail Driving
pitch: Three distinct off-road vehicles, three timed trails, a coherent forest park, and reusable driving modules.

authorization.basis: User executes PROMPT.md: routine design, implementation, local dependencies, asset authoring, validation, bounded agents and local milestone commits are delegated.

mustHave: All BRIEF.md requirements: Jeep, ATV, dirt bike, three 60–150 second routes, garage/free drive/trials/results/retry, medals and persistent records
Terrain contacts, collisions, suspension, bike balance, driver/chase views, audio, settings, recovery, focus safety
Nine real-input runs, independent engineering and bounded art review, framework extraction

milestones.title: Complete first loop
deliverables: Jeep selection through result and retry
acceptance: Real driving, terrain, collision, camera, pause and recovery

milestones.title: Complete vehicle roster
deliverables: ATV and bike motion and animated presentation
acceptance: Distinct handling, mounted/chase camera and transitions

milestones.title: Complete game
deliverables: Three routes, progression, audio, effects and presentation
acceptance: Nine combinations playable with local persistence

milestones.title: Acceptance
acceptance: Nine normal-speed real-input completions, edge cases, performance, engineering fixes and art 8/10 or four rounds

milestones.title: Framework-dev
acceptance: Canonical tests, usage docs, registry, framework checks, review and commit

playthrough: All nine vehicle/route combinations at normal speed using keyboard input
Gate order/direction, finish eligibility, recovery, restart, pause/focus, switching cameras/vehicles, storage and resource lifecycle

stopAfter: Game acceptance, bounded review, framework-dev extraction/review, committed handoff, run cleanup and task process shutdown.
